GlobalVar.description: GlobalVar overrides one named Central Economy variable.

name.description: Name is the built-in CE variable identifier, such as `AnimalMaxCount` or `CleanupLifetimeDefault`.

type.description: Type tells CE how to parse Value: 0 for integer, 1 for floating-point, and 2 for string.

value.description: Value is the variable's configured value encoded as text and interpreted according to Type.

GlobalsFile.description: GlobalsFile sets mission-wide Central Economy variables in `db/globals.xml`, including spawn limits, cleanup timing, and persistence-related behavior.

var.description: Vars are the CE variables overridden by this mission.

variables.description: XMLName identifies the required `<variables>` document root.
